tasks.spec: Run the full billed Stage 7 door screen once after successful dry and reviewed-smoke checks. Own only bench/results/stage7-door-n12/ except verdicts/ and review-summary.json, plus append-only ledger lines. Source .env silently, use no uv and no git mutation. Run 12 trials per arm, exactly 72 rep-major rows in control, review, stale-scene, wording, fixed-control, bridge order. Hard maxima are 48 raw 2A requests, 288 continuation requests, 336 Cloudflare requests total and 144 raw-player attempts; no judges, retries, replacement samples or smoke pooling. Preserve all source prompt hashes, exact allowed diffs, fixed bridge reconstruction, raw proposals, parsed segments, narrator-only text, composed screens, package/state hashes, eligible/matched evidence IDs, commands, responses, rejection rollback, before/after facts, request reservations, row hashes and partial failure artifacts. The raw adapter uses provider_for then provider._request({system,user,max_tokens:1024,response_format:{type:json_object}}) and parse_turn_proposal; continuation uses the normal RuntimeEngine.turn path with semantic_ask=None and no ItemFacts/world-capture/name matching. Exactly one eligible matcher hit and a committed reveal by command 1 or 2 is required for an earned result. Stop on quota, outage, malformed player output or exhausted caps, write run-failure.txt, and exit nonzero. The result is a wording screen only: it cannot claim hosted validation, semantic grounding, transition invariance, adoption, or authorial approval.
